newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania shilling gains on pound, steady on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania shilling gains on pound, steady on dollar.

text.p: The Tanzanian shilling appreciated against the pound but remained virtually unchanged against the dollar on Friday, the central bank said.
It said the shilling traded at a commerical mean rate of 590.3766 against the dollar compared to 590.5350 on Thursday.
On the pound, the shilling was posted at an average of 916.1774 from 922.2105 on Thursday.
The shilling's volatility against the pound was due to the pound's infrequent use as a major local trading currency.
Dealers said they expected the shilling to stay stable for at least the next three-months, trading within the 590-596 band.
"We don't expect it to fluctuate that much, the central bank is quite happy with it in that band," a dealer said.

He said there were a lot of dollars in the market place at the moment and extra cash would enter the market in October with strong sales expected for the cashew crop. The third biggest agricultural earner after coffee and cotton.
"Cashew -- a big crop is going to kick in October and exporters are going to receive funds," the dealer said.
Asked to assess the government's handling of the economy, he said therew was "steadily increasing confidence".

Two key factors which have reinforced confidence in the market were a reasonably stable inflation rate of around 24 percent and stable interest rates. Other factors included the International Monetary Fund's imminent granting of an Enhanced Structural Adjustment Facility worth $234 million to Tanzania in October.
